raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in its first analysis step. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the information that Emma Bull was born on December 13, 1954, the Planner incorrectly stated in its "Analysis of Previous Result" that Emma Bull was born in 1854. This introduced a false data point (1854 vs 1954) which, although corrected in the very next step, represents the first instance of a factual error in the reasoning chain. The error stems from a misreading or hallucination of the year digit during the initial processing of the search results.
